widgets_values:
# ComfyUI Studio — compatibility/optimization notes
WD14 tagging is supplementary and does not modify the Qwen captions or generated output. For character detection, inspect the WD14 tags. High-confidence matches can be applied manually, or integrated programmatically into ComfyUI Studio later. This graph intentionally retains original model files, sampler settings, and FreeOllamaVRAM hooks. Qwen captioner still requires separate debugging for the earlier HTTP 400 error; localhost URL is already set correctly.

nodes.title: MODEL GUIDE — WAN 2.2 VIDEO — READ BEFORE SELECTING
widgets_values:
# MODEL FAMILY: WAN 2.2 VIDEO

**Compatible model examples / model location:**
Use Wan 2.2-compatible high/low noise model weights already configured.

**Important:** Do not substitute Qwen Image, Krea 2, SDXL, or LTX weights. The Qwen3-VL Abliterated dropdown is Ollama CAPTIONING only, not the video generator.

**Ollama caption model vs image model:** In `Qwen3VLAbliteratedPromptPair`, `huihui_ai/qwen3-vl-abliterated:8b-instruct` is an **Ollama image-analysis model**, not your generation checkpoint.

**ComfyUI limitation:** Standard dropdowns still list all matching file types from shared folders; this note and labeled loader indicate what is appropriate, but do not restrict dropdown contents.
